The '''Czerka Sentient Resources Department''' was a division of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] that was in charge of recruitment. Foreman [[Gragov]], [[Sentient Resources Specialist]] [[Hawek Yellip]], and chief of security [[Zokar]] were each employees of the department.
